meta.title: TOW24 – Professional Towing Service in Iceland | 24/7
meta.description: TOW24 provides fast, professional towing and roadside assistance across Iceland around the clock. Call now and we'll be with you shortly.

hero.sub: Fast, reliable and professional towing and roadside assistance throughout Iceland — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

services.label: SERVICES
services.title: WHAT WE OFFER
services.desc: We provide a full range of towing and roadside assistance services across Iceland.

items.name: Towing Service
items.desc: Vehicle transport to a garage, home, or any other destination. Suitable for all types of vehicles.

items.name: Flat Tyre
items.desc: On-site tyre change or transport if the tyre is too damaged to repair on location.

items.name: Battery Issues
items.desc: Jump start with booster cables or on-site battery replacement when you need to get moving.

items.name: Fuel Delivery
items.desc: Fuel delivery or restart after running out. We arrive quickly so you're not stranded long.

items.name: Lockout
items.desc: Help when your keys are locked inside the car. Fast and damage-free unlocking.

items.name: Off-Road Recovery
items.desc: Vehicle extraction when stuck in mud, snow, or completely off-road.

why.label: WHY TOW24
why.title: SERVICE YOU CAN COUNT ON
why.desc: We prioritise speed, safety and professionalism every single time.

items.title: Fast Response
items.text: We arrive within 30–60 minutes on average, wherever you are in Iceland.

items.title: Expert Knowledge
items.text: Experienced team with expertise in all types of vehicles, from cars to heavy trucks.

items.title: Fair Pricing
items.text: Clear pricing with no hidden fees. You know the cost before we start any work.

items.title: 24/7 Service
items.text: Open every day, at any hour. We always answer when you need us most.

cta.title: NEED HELP RIGHT NOW?
cta.sub: Give us a call and we'll be on our way.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1: TOW24 operates the website tow24.is and provides towing and roadside assistance services in Iceland. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. Contact: info@tow24.is
privacy.s2intro: We may collect the following data when you use our website or contact us:
s2items: Name and contact information (phone number, email) when you call or contact us
Technical data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time of visit (via cookies)
Language preference and theme preference stored in cookies on your device
s3items: Provide our towing and roadside assistance services
Remember your language and theme preferences
s4items: tow24_lang — Stores your language preference. Expires after 365 days.
tow24_theme — Stores your chosen colour theme. Expires after 365 days.
tow24_cookie_consent — Stores your cookie consent choice. Expires after 365 days.
privacy.s4p2: These are strictly functional cookies. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. You may decline cookies; the website will still function, but your preferences will not be saved.
privacy.s5: We use Google Fonts to load web fonts. This may cause your browser to contact Google servers. We do not share your personal data with any other third parties.
privacy.s6: We only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services or as required by law.
privacy.s7: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at info@tow24.is.
privacy.s8: Our website uses HTTPS encryption. We take reasonable technical measures to protect your data.
privacy.s9: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of the page shows when it was last revised.
privacy.s10: For any questions about this policy, please contact: info@tow24.is
